title: DuoRate: Two-Rate Per-Expert Precision Allocation for Mixture-of-Experts Serving
abstract: arXiv:2610.13328v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Serving a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model pays for expert precision twice: the resident footprint pays for every expert the router can reach, while each batch-one decode step pays only for the experts it selects. These are two different rate functionals over the same per-expert widths, yet published per-expert MoE allocators constrain only the first. We call the difference the store-read gap; in the released BitsMoE checkpoint, 2.54 bits per weight (bpw) of storage become 7.50 bpw of decode traffic. We propose DuoRate, which stores once and reads per workload. Offline, it stores one uniform tier of a prefix-readable weight stream and bakes a distortion tensor. Online, it profiles a workload's own prefill without labels and solves a Lagrangian rate-distortion allocation under the decode functional; routing frequency provably cancels from every per-expert decision, and the solve costs one dot product per expert and a bisection. A deployment

translated_title: DuoRate：面向混合专家模型服务的双速率逐专家精度分配
translated_abstract: 服务混合专家模型需要为专家精度付出两次代价：常驻内存占用需要为路由器可达的每一个专家付费，而每个批量大小为1的解码步骤只需为其选中的专家付费。这是作用在相同的逐专家宽度上的两个不同的速率泛函，然而已发表的逐专家MoE分配器只约束了前者。我们将这种差异称为“存储-读取差距”（store-read gap）；在已发布的BitsMoE检查点中，每权重2.54比特（bpw）的存储量在解码时变成了每权重7.50比特的流量。我们提出DuoRate，它只存储一次，而按工作负载读取。离线阶段，它存储一个前缀可读权重流的统一精度层级，并预先计算一个失真张量。在线阶段，它无需标签地剖析工作负载自身的预填充过程，并在解码泛函下求解拉格朗日率失真分配问题；可以证明路由频率在每个逐专家决策中都被消去，求解成本仅为每个专家一次点积和一次二分查找。
tldr: 针对MoE模型中存储占用与解码流量这两种不同速率需求之间的“存储-读取差距”，DuoRate提出离线存储单一精度层级、在线依据工作负载自身的预填充特征求解解码泛函下的率失真分配，实现逐专家精度的双速率优化。
en_tdlr: DuoRate bridges the store-read gap in MoE serving—where resident storage and per-step decode traffic demand different per-expert precisions—by storing one uniform tier offline and solving a Lagrangian rate-distortion allocation online under the decode functional, using only a label-free prefill profile, one dot product per expert, and a bisection.
